el-rey-del-mundo-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Launched in 1882 under Antonio Allones, El Rey del Mundo was conceived as a premium brand in both quality and price. Filler and wrapper come from the Vuelta Abajo, and the blend is light to medium and consistent. The Choix Suprême robusto begins woody and earthy with a little spice, then gains pepper, almond and cream as it fills out toward a long finish.

thirds.notes: Mostly woody with a hint of spice and earth, light in body, low on the palate and quick to fade.
The flavours sharpen into wood, pepper and almond over earth, and a new creaminess smooths the smoke.
The fullest stage: creamier and heartier, with a lingering finish and no harshness despite the heat.

el-rey-del-mundo-cuba--royal-series.description: Presented in Cyprus in December 2023, the Royal Series is a 50 x 155 mm El Rey del Mundo in the Dobles format, made for La Casa del Habano shops and boxed in twenties. Habanos rates it light to medium, fresh and aromatic with wood and light toast; reviewers find cappuccino and hazelnut, then herbs and a late touch of spice.

thirds.notes: Cappuccino and hazelnut, then wood and herbs over a quiet background sweetness.
Little changes: the same coffee, nut and wood profile at a steady strength.
A light spice joins the profile as the strength settles at medium.
